text:
raj: Heads up — after the NVIDIA 535 driver rollout to the H100 canary pool in us-west-2 we started seeing a spike in TensorRT failures and a few jobs with FlashAttention/xFormers panics. Canary shows ~8% error rate vs ~0.1% baseline.

infra-bot: driver-upgrade: completed rollout to pool h100-canary-usw2 at 1815238600.

kevin: attaching the most common error from a TRT worker: 
```
[2026-11-03T21:10:12Z] [TRT] ERROR: failed to load kernel module: ptxas returned error
ptxas fatal   : ValueError: ptx verification failed for function flash_attn_fwd
```

maria: also seeing NCCL warnings in the same timeframe on a subset of nodes, not all. Logs show `libnccl.so ABI mismatch` intermittently.

olivia: this smells like PTX/driver incompat between compiled kernels (xformers/flashattn prebuilt) and the new driver. We ship some wheel builds compiled against CUDA 12.x toolchain — driver 535 may be stricter about PTX versions.

kevin: confirmed on one host: `nvidia-smi --query-gpu=driver_version,cuda_version --format=csv` -> `535.86.10, 12.2` but our optimized kernels were built with `nvcc 12.1` and include legacy PTX.

raj: quick triage — do we see this only on H100 or also A100? so far only H100-canary. Could be PTX JIT path differences.

maria: only H100 pool so far (canary). A100 fleet in other regions OK.

olivia: immediate mitigation options: 1) roll driver back on canary to 530, 2) rebuild xFormers/FlashAttention wheels with PTX compatible level and push; rebuilding will take hours and validation. Rollback is fastest for outage mitigation.

sre-oncall: recommend rollback for canary and pause rollout. If errors stop we confirm regression. We should not touch Dedicated prod until canary green.

kevin: I can trigger revert for the h100-canary pool now. Will run a small validation suite against TRT models after revert.

raj: go ahead kevin. Please annotate nodes in inventory (tag: driver-535-failed) so we can query later. Also capture `dmesg` and `journalctl` from failing nodes — include stack traces.

kevin: rolling back canary now. command: `infractl drivers revert --pool h100-canary-usw2 --version 530.41`

infra-bot: driver-change: revert to 530.41 started at 1815239803 by kevin.

kevin: post-rollback quick check: TRT jobs that were failing now pass on 6/6 sampled containers. Error rate dropped to baseline. Will keep monitoring for 30m.

olivia: next steps: create a compatibility matrix doc mapping driver versions -> supported PTX/cc targets for our prebuilt kernels, and add an automated smoke test that runs TRT/FlashAttention synthetic workloads on canary after any driver change.

raj: agreed. olivia, can you own the matrix doc and tests? kevin, please prepare a steamlined rollback playbook for infra runbooks. maria, collect the failing node artifacts and add to the ticket.

maria: on it — uploading tarball of /var/log/nvidia* and `dmesg` snippets to the incident ticket.

kevin: added rollback runbook draft to the infra runbooks page. Will include the infractl commands and validation queries.

raj: thanks everyone — pausing driver rollout until we have a validated compatibility matrix and an automated canary smoke gate. :white_check_mark:

sre-oncall: noting action items in incident tracker: INCIDENT-2026-1123-driver-compat.

raj: filing a follow-up to coordinate with ML infra and model infra teams for wheel rebuild plan if we decide to re-certify 535.

kevin: for follow-up, we should test both NVRTC and PTX JIT paths and confirm whether `ptxas` in 535 changed checks. I'll open a small repro job that compiles flashattn kernels at runtime and compare ptxas outputs.

olivia: FYI, add check for TensorRT plugin ABI too — some TRT plugins vendor-packaged might need rebuild against 535.

raj: closing thread for now; monitoring continues. Ping here for any regression spikes.
